tools.name: find_shop
tools.description: Search merchants/shops by free-text query (name or domain fragment), optionally filtered by country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. "DE"). Returns the public shop view only — shops still under internal review are never returned. If many shops match, grouping by country or category keeps the list scannable

tools.name: get_shop
tools.description: Fetch a single merchant/shop by id or domain (public view). Returns "shop not found" for shops still under internal review, identical to a genuinely unknown domain — reviewers cannot be distinguished from typos. The offers array is present for schema stability but empty until merchant offers are ing

tools.name: list_coupons
tools.description: List currently visible discount codes/coupons, optionally filtered by shop_domain (e.g. "example-shop.com"). findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "report_code" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
